claim: Why aren't more of us on Adam4Adam? : r/grindr - Reddit
summary: Adam4Adam is great, but it needs more people. Like Gaydar, it was the best site ever, but it took too long to develop an app. Once people got smartphones, they switched to Grindr, with all its flaws. The Gaydar app now is much better than Grindr, but there aren't enough people on it. If A4A had the same user base as Grindr, it would wipe Grindr ...
